data.one_liner: Dart client for Plex Media Server and plex.tv supporting sign-in, libraries, streaming, and search.
data.what_it_does: Provides a typed Dart client for interacting with Plex Media Server and plex.tv. Handles JWT sign-in, server discovery, library browsing, playlists, playback reporting, search, and audio/video streaming URLs.
use_when: Building a Plex client application in Dart or Flutter
Streaming media or browsing libraries from a Plex Media Server
avoid_when: Building applications that do not use Plex Media Server
Needing a UI component library rather than an API client
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Plex Media Server and plex.tv APIs
Typed models with background isolate parsing for large responses
Supports JWT sign-in, automatic token refresh, and server discovery
weaknesses: Tied specifically to Plex Media Server architecture
Requires manual implementation of media playback engines using the provided transcode URLs
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart 3.10 or later and valid Plex credentials.
